agents.what: What the sixty-three corrections are actually worth
agents.why: Sixty-three funding rules are wrongly encoded — each one checked against the funder's own published page, with the quote and the reasoning written down. Fixing them is waiting on your approval because it means writing to the database. So far the case for them is an internal counter: wrongly excluded funds fall from 251 to 14. That is not the same as founders getting better answers. This measures what they would move on the real end-to-end number, so the decision comes with the figure that matters rather than the one that is easy to produce.
